technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term uptrend structure but lacks near-term momentum confirmation; oversold technicals (RSI-9, Stoch, Williams %R) are rising but without bullish crossovers or volume support, making this a weak swing entry despite macro bullish alignment.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases, 1 sale by junior Democrats), neutral AAII/fear-greed readings, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 20 days compounds volatility risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term uptrend structure (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish, price above 200-day MA, supertrend bullish, ADX directional) with oversold oscillators (RSI-9, Stoch 6.84, Williams %R) near support (130.97) offers classic mean-reversion setup if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Absence of bullish confirmation signals (no RSI/Stoch crossovers, negative MACD histogram, weak CMF, no OBV/AO support), combined with crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, high earnings risk in 20 days, and zero fundamental conviction creates unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
